limitations: Unadjusted iid t intervals are descriptive and optimistic: groups were selected, matches share days/leagues, and multiple testing is not corrected.
31 October is partial with open entries; primary daily comparison excludes it.
Before/after differences and common-league cuts do not identify causality.
Original-entry forward split uses exact freeze timestamp; resolved-after-freeze is not treated as a new entry.
Research first-entry group results are not executed user bets or a deduplicated manual LIVE portfolio.

findings.finding: Daily admission requires N>30 and positive ROI excluding three best matches; no independent validation or uncertainty test is required by scripts/live_daily.py.

The 24 October original-entry audit tested 37099 distinct subsets. Its approximate normal-test BH procedure reported zero rejections at 0.05. The candidate shortlist was selected after all outcomes were examined; its temporal checks were retrospective.
All four groups frozen on 29 October produced negative returns on subsequently entered matches. Exact timestamp splitting excludes earlier entries that settled later. See forward.
No group with N>30 has an unadjusted iid two-sided 95% t interval wholly above zero in the 31 October 16:48 Moscow report. This is descriptive, not a valid post-selection guarantee.

Catalog hashes for all four frozen groups match current report hashes. The earlier audit found unchanged key predicates/ranking on 26-29 October. Temporary history-reader damage on 29 October caused an invalid report, subsequently restored.
Original selected groups overlap: 1179 pocket entries represent 889 matches, 233 matches appear in multiple groups.

Coverage of eligible repeated observation points with complete detail was 95.1% on 26 October,82.1% on 28 October,94.5% on29 October,and60.3% on31 October through current snapshot. This is not unique-match coverage and does not include failed periods without observed demand.
The shares of deterioration attributable to winner selection, random results, league mix, missing acquisition, and a true change in expected returns cannot be causally identified from these few days.
Research first qualifying entries and manual LIVE selection/publication are different pipelines. Exact provider quote profitability is not proof of executable user-bet profitability.

recommended_validation: Keep a complete registry of tested hypotheses and retain losing histories. Mark discovery, validation, and deployment separately.

Freeze each candidate and selection policy before evaluating fresh entries; use an untouched prospective cohort and predeclared decision time or a valid sequential method. Do not keep retuning on that validation cohort.
Size validation for the desired edge and observed volatility; count days,league coverage,and event dependence instead of an arbitrary N30 threshold. Account for hypothesis multiplicity.
Evaluate uncertainty and results excluding best day/league, not only three best individual outcomes. Do not infer that every arbitrary league filter is profitable.
Validate the actual deduplicated manual top-group portfolio including first available quotes,latency,publication time,and executable prices.
Monitor collection completeness and actual request-to-completion cadence separately from calculation freshness; keep gaps explicit.
